info.description: Map coordinates for one dealer, keyed by dealer-submission documentId. Holds no PII — these coordinates are published on /find-dealer. Replaces the old frontend/src/lib/dealer-geocodes.json sidecar, so a wrong pin is now an admin edit instead of a code deploy. Deliberately a SEPARATE collection rather than fields on dealer-submission: that collection is a stand-in for a real dealer API and the client forbade adding fields to it, and a separate collection re-keys cleanly when the stand-in is replaced.
